English: In this chapter, we focus on mathematical models of tuberculosis epidemiology (TB) that include interactions with HIV and an explicit representation of transmission.
Luganda: Mu ssuula eno, tutunuulidde emitetenkanyirizo kinnakubala egy’ekaliriza akafuba (TB) omuli okutunuulira HIV n’ensaasaana nga bw’efaanana.
Yoruba: Ní orí yìí, a gbójú mọ́ àwọn módẹ́ẹ̀lì matimátíìsì ìmọ ìmójútó àìsàn ikọ́ ife (TB) tó níṣe pẹ̀lú ìṣepọ̀ HIV àti ìṣojú ìtàkálẹ̀.
Zulu: Kulesi sahluko, sigxile kumamodeli ezibalo zesifo sofuba (TB) ahlanganisa ukusebenzisana ne-HIV kanye nokuvela okusobala kokudluliswa.
Hausa: A wannan babi, mun mayar da hankali ne a kan samfurorin lissafi na yaɗuwar annobar tarin fuka (TB) waɗanda suka haɗa da hulɗa tare da cutar HIV da kuma wakiltar bayyanar yaɗuwa.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo kgaolong ye, re nepišitše go mekgwa ya mmetse ya thutatwetši ya TB (TB) yeo e akaretšago dikamano le HIV le kemelo ka botlalo ya phetetšo.
Amharic: በዚህ ምእራፍ ውስጥ፣ ከኤችአይቪ ጋር የመስተጋብሮችን እና መተላለፍ ግልፅ ውክልናን በሚያካትቱ የሳንባ ነቀርሳ ኤፒዲሚዮሎጂ (ቲቢ) የሂሳብ ሞዴሎች ላይ እናተኩራለን።

English: We review the natural history of TB and illustrate how its features are simplified and incorporated in mathematical models.
Luganda: Tutuunulira ensibuko ya TB era ne twoleka obubonero bwe gye bugonzebwa era ne buteekebwa mu mitetenkanyirizo kinnakubala.
Yoruba: A ṣe àyẹ̀wo ìtan TB a sì yàwòrán bí àwọn ìwòmọ́ rẹ̀ ṣe rọrùn àti ba ṣe fi wón sínú àwọn módẹ́ẹ̀lì matimátíìsì náà.
Zulu: Sibuyekeza umlando wemvelo we-TB futhi sibonisa ukuthi izici zayo zenziwa lula futhi zifakwe kanjani kumamodeli ezibalo.
Hausa: Mun yi bitar tarihin TB da kuma kwatanta yadda aka sauƙaƙa fasalullukansa da kuma haɗa su cikin samfurorin lissafi.
Northern Sotho: Re lekodišiša histori ya tlhago ya TB le go laetša ka fao ditlabelo tša yona di nolofatšwago ka gona le go tsenywa ka go mekgwa ya mmetse.
Amharic: የቲቢን የተፈጥሮ ታሪክ እንገመግማለን እና ባህሪያቱ እንዴት እንደሚቃለሉ እና በሂሳብ ሞዴሎች ውስጥ እንደሚካተቱ እናሳያለን።

English: We then review the ways HIV influences the natural history of TB, the interventions that have been considered in models, and the way these individual-level effects are represented in models.
Luganda: Ate olwo ne twekenneenya engeri HIV gy’akosaamu ebyafaayo bya TB, kaweefube atunuuliddwa mu mitetenkanyirizo egyo, ate n’engeri okukosebwa okwo kinnakumu gye kukiikrirrwa mu mitetenkanyirizo egyo.
Yoruba: Tí a bá ṣe àyẹ̀wo ọ̀nà bí HIV ṣe nípa lórí ìtan TB, àwọn ìdásí tí a ti gbehwò nínú àwọn módéẹ̀lì náà, àti bí àwọn ipele kọ̀ọ̀kan wọ̀nyí ṣe ń nípa lórí ìṣojú nínú àwọn módẹ́ẹ̀lì náà.
Zulu: Sibe sesibuyekeza izindlela i-HIV enomthelela ngayo emlandweni wemvelo we-TB, ukungenelela okuye kwacatshangwa kumamodeli, kanye nendlela le miphumela yezinga lomuntu ngamunye emelelwa ngayo kumamodeli.
Hausa: Sannan kuma mu yi bitar hanyoyin da HIV yake yin tasiri a tarihin TB, ayyukan da aka yi la’akari da su a cikin samfurorin, da kuma yadda ake wakiltar waɗannan tasirin matakin mutum a cikin samfurorin.
Northern Sotho: Go tloga fao re lekola ditsela tšeo ka tšona HIV e huetšago histori ya tlhago ya TB, ditsenogare tšeo di bego di bonwa ka go mekgwa, le ka fao diabe tše tša maemo a motho ka o tee di emetšwego ka gare ga mekgwa ye.
Amharic: ከዚያም ኤችአይቪ በቲቢ የተፈጥሮ ታሪክ ላይ ተጽእኖ የሚያሳድርባቸውን መንገዶች፣ በሞዴልነት የታሰቡትን ጣልቃ ገብነቶች፣ እና እነዚህ የግለሰባዊ ተፅእኖዎች በሞዴሎች ውስጥ የሚወከሉበትን መንገድ እንገመግማለን።

English: We then go on to consider population-level effects, reviewing the TB/HIV modelling literature.
Luganda: Tutunuulira okukosebwa okutuuse ku bantu nga twekaliriza okunoonyereza okwakolebwa okukwata ku TB/HIV.
Yoruba: A sì lọ láti wo ipa ipele-olùgbé, ṣíṣàyẹ̀wo ìmọ̀ àtẹ̀yìnwá módẹ́ẹ̀lì TB/HIV.
Zulu: Sibe sesiqhubeka nokubheka imiphumela yezinga labantu, sibuyekeza izincwadi zokumodela ze-TB/HIV.
Hausa: Daga nan sai mu ka ci gaba da yin la'akari da tasirin matakin yawan jama'a, muna nazarin wallafe-wallafe a kan samfurin TB/HIV.
Northern Sotho: Go tloga fao re tšwela pele go lekola diabe tša maemo a setšhaba, ra lekola dingwalwa tša go lekola TB/HIV.
Amharic: በመቀጠልም የቲቢ/ኤችአይቪ ሞዴሊንግ ጽሑፎችን በመገምገም፣ በሕዝብ ደረጃ ላይ ያሉትን ተፅዕኖዎች ግምት ውስጥ ማስገባት እንቀጥላለን።

English: We first review studies whose focus was on purely epidemiological modelling, and then studies whose focus was on modelling the impact of interventions.
Luganda: Tusooka ne twekaliriza okunooneyreza okwatunuulira ddala emitetenkanyirizo gy’endwaddwa, ate n’okunooyereza okwatunuulira emitetenkanyirizo gy’amagezi agasalwa okulwanyisa endwadde.
Yoruba: A kọ́kọ́ ṣe àyẹ̀wò ìmọ̀ tó dá lórí módẹ́ẹ̀lì ìtànkálẹ̀, a ṣẹ̀ wá wo àwọn tó dá lórí módẹ́ẹ̀lì ipa ìdásí.
Zulu: Siqale sibuyekeze izifundo okugxilwe kuzo ekumodeleni kuphela ngokwempathazwe, bese kuba izifundo ezigxile ekuboniseni umthelela wokungenelela.
Hausa: Da farko mun sake nazarin binciken da aka mayar da hankali a kan samfurin annoba kawai, sannan kuma binciken da aka mayar da hankali a kan samfurin tasirin sa-baki.
Northern Sotho: Sa mathomo re lekola dinyakišišo tšeo nepišo ya tšona e bego ele kudu go tekolo ya thutotwetši, le gape dinyakišišo tše nepišo ya tšona e bego e le go tekolo ya seabe sa ditsenogare.
Amharic: በመጀመሪያ ትኩረታቸው በንፁህ ኤፒዲሚዮሎጂያዊ ሞዴሊንግ ላይ የተደረጉ ጥናቶችን፣ እና ከዚያም ትኩረታቸው የጣልቃ ገብነትን ተፅእኖ ሞዴሊንግ ላይ ያተኮሩ ጥናቶችን እንገመግማለን።

English: We conclude with a summary of the uses and achievements of TB/HIV modelling and some suggested future directions.
Luganda: Tukubira n’ekifunze ekiraga emigaso n’emiganyulo gy’emitetenkanyirizo gya TB/HIV ate n’ebiyinza okukolebwa gye bujja.
Yoruba: A fẹnukò pẹ̀lú ìṣoráńpẹ́ ìlò àti ̀ṣeyọrí módẹ́ẹ̀lì TB/HIV àti àwọn èro ọ̀na ọjọ́ọwájú.
Zulu: Siphetha ngesifinyezo sokusetshenziswa nempumelelo yokumodela kwe-TB/HIV kanye nezinkombandlela zesikhathi esizayo ezisikiselwe.
Hausa: Mun ƙare da taƙaitaccen amfani da nasarorin da aka samu na ƙirar TB/HIV da wasu shawarwarin da aka ba da shawarar nan gaba.
Northern Sotho: Re fetša ka kakaretšo ya mehola le diphihlelelo tša ditekodišišo tša TB/HIV le ditaetšo tše di šišinywago tša ka moso.
Amharic: የቲቢ/ኤችአይቪ ሞዴሊንግ አጠቃቀሞች እና ግኝቶች እና አንዳንድ የተጠቆሙ የወደፊት አቅጣጫዎችን ጠቅለል አድርገን እንጨርሳለን።

English: Mathematical models are a big help to health scientists and policy makers wanting to better understand the situation of people living with both HIV and tuberculosis, and which of their plans to fight it work best.
Luganda: Emitetenkanyirizo kinnakubala buyambi bwamaanyi eri bannassaayansi ab’ebyobulamu n’abakola ku byamateeka abaagala okutegeera obulungi embeera abantu abalina HIV n’akafuba mwe babeera, ate n’okumanya nteekateeka ki ku ezo ze balina eyinza okukola obulungi.
Yoruba: Àwọn módẹ́ẹ̀lì matimátíìsì jẹ́ ìrànwọ́ ńlá fún àwon onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì ìlera àti aṣòfin tọ́ fẹ́ mọ ipò àwọn ẹni tó ń gbé pẹ̀lú HIV àti ikọ́ ife, àti èwo nínú èto wọn ni ó lè jìjàkadì pẹ̀lú àwọn àìsàn yìí jù.
Zulu: Izibonelo zezibalo ziwusizo olukhulu kososayensi bezempilo kanye nabakhi bezinqubomgomo abafuna ukuqonda kangcono isimo sabantu abaphila ne-HIV nesifo sofuba, nokuthi yiziphi izinhlelo zabo zokulwa nayo ezisebenza kangcono.
Hausa: Samfurorin lissafi suna taimakawas masana kimiyyar kiwon lafiya da masu tsara manufofin da suke son fahimtar yanayin mutanen da uke da HIV da kuma tarin fuka, da kuma waɗanne ire-iren tsare-tsarensu na yaƙar ne za su fi aiki sosai.
Northern Sotho: Mekgwa ya mmetse ke thušo ye kgolo go bašomi ba tša mahlale ba maphelo le bahlami ba melao bao ba nyakago go kwešiša bokaone seemo sa batho bao ba phelago ka bobedi HIV le TB, le gore ke maano afe a bona a go e lwantšha ao a šomago bokaone.
Amharic: የሂሣብ ሞዴሎች ከሁለቱም ከኤችአይቪ እና ከሳንባ ነቀርሳ ጋር የሚኖሩ ሰዎችን ሁኔታ በደንብ ለመረዳት ለሚፈልጉ የጤና ሳይንቲስቶች እና ፖሊሲ አውጪዎች ትልቅ እገዛ ሲሆን፣ እና እሱን ለመዋጋት ካቀዱት ውስጥ የትኛው የተሻለ እንደሚሰራ ለመረዳት ያግዛል።

English: An increase in people being infected with the HIV virus in the 1990s coincided with many more cases of tuberculosis (TB).
Luganda: Okweyongera kw’abantu abakwatibwa akawuka ka HIV mu myaka gya 1990 kwakwatagana n’obulwadde bungi obw’akafuba (TB).
Yoruba: Ìpọ̀si níye àwọn tó ní ìkóràn àìsan HIV ní 1990s jẹ́ bákan náà pẹ̀lú ọ̀pọ ẹ̀sun ikọ́ ife (TB).
Zulu: Ukwanda kwabantu abangenwa igciwane lesandulela ngculazi ngeminyaka ye-1990 kwaqondana nezigameko eziningi zesifo sofuba (TB).
Hausa: Yawan mutanen da suke kamuwa da ƙswayar cutar HIV a cikin hekarun 1990 ya zo daidai da yawaitar cututtukan tarin fuka (TB).
Northern Sotho: Koketšego ya batho bao ba fetetšwego ke baerase ya HIV ka mengwageng ya bo 1990 e sepelelane le diphetetšo tše ntši tša bolwetši bja mafahla (TB).
Amharic: በ1990ዎቹ በኤችአይቪ ቫይረስ የተያዙ ሰዎች መጨመር ከብዙ የሳንባ ነቀርሳ (ቲቢ) ጉዳዮች ጋር የተጋጣጠመ ነው።

English: This was especially true for countries in sub-Saharan Africa.
Luganda: Kino kyasinga kulabikira mu mawanga agali wansi w’eddungu lya Sahara mu Afirika.
Yoruba: Èyí jẹ́ òótọ́ pàápàá fún àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè tó wà ní agbègbe Sahara Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Lokhu bekuyiqiniso ikakhulukazi emazweni ase-Afrika esezansi yeSahara.
Hausa: Hakan ya kasance gaskiya ne musamman ga ƙasashen da suke Afirka kudu da Sahara.
Northern Sotho: Se se ile sa tloga se diregile kudu go dinaga tša ka borwa bja Afrika.
Amharic: ይህ በተለይ ከሰሃራ በታች ባሉ የአፍሪካ ሀገራት እውነት ነበር።

English: By the late 1990s, for example, over 70% of Zimbabwe’s TB cases were reported among people also living with HIV.
Luganda: Okugeza, emyaka gya 1990 we gyaggweerako, abalwadde b’akafuba abasukka mu 70% mu Zimbabwe era be bamu abaali balina HIV.
Yoruba: Ní òpin 1990s, bí àpẹẹrẹ, ó lé ní ìdá 70% àwọn ọmọ orílè ède Zimbabwe tí ẹ̀sun TB jẹ́ fífisùn láàárín àwọn tó ń gbé pẹ̀lú àìsan HIV.
Zulu: Ngasekupheleni kweminyaka ye-1990, isibonelo, ngaphezu kwama-70% wabantu baseZimbabwe abane-TB babikwa kubantu abaphila ne-HIV.
Hausa: A ƙarshen shekarun 1990, misali, sama da kashi 70% na masu kamuwa da cutar TB a Zimbabwe aka bayars da rahotonsu a tsakanin mutanen da suke ɗauke da cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Go fa mafelelong a bo 1990, go fa mohlala, poalo ya go feta 70% balwetši ba TB ka Zimbabwe ba ile ba begwa magareng ga batho bao ba phelago ka HIV.
Amharic: በ1990ዎቹ መገባደጃ ላይ፣ ለምሳሌ፣ ከ70% በላይ የሚሆኑት የዚምባብዌ የቲቢ ጉዳዮች ከኤችአይቪ ጋር የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ጋር ሪፖርት ተደርገዋል።

English: The number of co-occurring HIV and TB cases have fortunately dropped since around 2004, after countries such as South Africa and Botswana began providing antiretroviral therapy (ART) to HIV patients.
Luganda: Ekirungi, omuwendo gw’abantu abalina HIV ne TB kukkidde ddala okuva mu 2004, oluvannyuma lw’amawanga gamba nga South Afirika ne Botwswana okutandika okugabira abantu eddagala erikkakkanya ku Mukenenya (ART) eri abantu abalina HIV.
Yoruba: Iye ìjẹyọpọ̀ ẹ̀sun HIV àti TB ti wá sílẹ̀ láti bí i 2004, lẹ́yìn tí àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè bí i South Africa àti Botswana bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí í fi Ìtọ́jú lọ́wọ́ Fáírọ́sì-Àǹtìrítíró (ART) sí aláìsan HIV.
Zulu: Izibalo ze-HIV ne-TB ezenzeka kanyekanye zehlile kusukela ngonyaka we-2004, ngemva kokuba amazwe afana neNingizimu Afrika neBotswana eqale ukuhlinzeka ngemishanguzo ye-zilwinamagciwane (ART) ezigulini ezine-HIV.
Hausa: Yawan masu kamuwa da cutar HIV da kuma TB ya ragu tun a wajajen shekara ta 2004, bayan da ƙasashe irin su Afirka ta Kudu da Botswana suka fara bayar da maganin cutar ƙanjamau (ART) ga masu cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Palo ya diphetetšo tše di diregago mmogo tša HIV le TB ka mahlatse di fokotšegile go tloga ka 2004, ka morago ga ge dinaga tša go swana le Afrika Borwa le Botswana di ile tša thoma ka go aba kalafo ka dianthorethobaerale (ART) go balwetši ba HIV.
Amharic: እንደ ደቡብ አፍሪካ እና ቦትስዋና ያሉ ሀገራት የፀረ ኤችአይቪ ህክምና (ART) ለኤችአይቪ ታማሚዎች መስጠት ከጀመሩ በኋላ፣ አብረው የሚከሰቱት የኤችአይቪ እና የቲቢ ኬዞች ቁጥር እንደ እድል ሆኖ ከ 2004 አካባቢ ጀምሮ ቀንሷል።

English: However, researchers predict that despite the availability of ARTs, HIV will continue to influence the occurrence and spread of TB for decades to come.
Luganda: Wabula, abanoonyereza bateebereza nti newankubadde nga waliwo ARTs, HIV ajja kweyongera okufuga obulwadde bwa TB my myaka mingi ddala egijja.
Yoruba: Wàyí o, àwọn olùṣèwádìí sàsọtẹ́lẹ̀ pé pẹ̀lú gbogbo ìwa ARTs, HIV yóò máa nípa lórí ìjẹyọ àti ìtànká TB fún àìmọye ọdún.
Zulu: Nokho, abacwaningi babikezela ukuthi naphezu kokuba khona kwama-ART, i-HIV izoqhubeka nokuba nomthelela ekuveleni nasekusabalaleni kwe-TB emashumini eminyaka ezayo.
Hausa: Duk da haka, masu binciken sun yi hasashen cewa duk da samun ARTs, cutar HIV za ta ci gaba da yin tasiri a kan kamuwa da kuma yaɗuwar TB a shekaru da yawa masu zuwa.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale, banyakišiši ba ile ba akanya gore go hwetšagala ga di-ART, HIV e tla tšwela pele go huetša go ba gona ga go phatlalatšwa ga TB mengwagasome ye e tlago.
Amharic: ይሁን እንጂ፣ ተመራማሪዎች እንደገመቱት (ARTs) ቢኖሩም፣ ኤችአይቪ ለብዙ አሥርተ ዓመታት በቲቢ መከሰት እና መስፋፋት ላይ ተጽእኖ ማሳደሩን ይቀጥላል።

English: Around 10% of TB cases worldwide are still being diagnosed among people who also live with HIV.
Luganda: Abalwadde abawera nga 10% mu nsi yonna bakyasangibwa nga be bamu ku abo abalina HIV.
Yoruba: Bí i 10% ẹ̀sun TB lágbàáyé ni wọ́n ń ṣàyẹ̀wò lé láàárín àwọn tó ní àìsàn HIV.
Zulu: Cishe ama-10% abantu abane-TB emhlabeni wonke basaxilongwa kubantu abaphila ne-HIV.
Hausa: Kusan kashi 10% na cututtukan TB a duniya har yanzu ana gano su ne a tsakanin mutanen da suke kuma ɗauke da cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Tekano ye e ka bago 10% ya balwetši ba TB lefaseng ka bophara ba sa phekotšwe gareng ga batho bao ba phelago ka HIV.
Amharic: በዓለም ዙሪያ 10% የሚሆኑት የቲቢ በሽታዎች አሁንም ከኤችአይቪ ጋር በሚኖሩ ሰዎች ላይ እየተመረመሩ ነው።

English: Some 74% of these cases are people from sub-Saharan Africa.
Luganda: Abantu 74% ku abo abalwadde basangibwa mu bitundu ebiri wansi w’eddungu Sahara mu Afirika.
Yoruba: Bí i 74% àwọn ẹ̀sùn wọ̀nyí jẹ́ àwọn ènìyàn láti agbègbe Sahara Africa.
Zulu: Amaphesenti angaba ngama-74 alezi zigameko ngabantu base-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara.
Hausa: Kusan kashi 74% na waɗannan kamuwa mutane ne daga yankin Afirka kudu da Sahara.
Northern Sotho: Tekano ya 74% ya balwetši ba ke batho bao ba tšwago ka borwa bja Afrika.
Amharic: ከእነዚህ ጉዳዮች ውስጥ 74% የሚሆኑት ከሰሃራ በታች ባለው አፍሪካ ያሉ ሰዎች ናቸው።

English: People who die from TB (the disease is curable thanks to treatment) often also had HIV.
Luganda: Abantu abafa olwa TB (buno obulwadde buwonyezeka olw’obujjanjabi obuliwo) era batera okubeera ne HIV.
Yoruba: Àwọn ẹni tó kú látara TB (àìsàn náà ṣe é wò ọpẹ́ fún ìtọ́jú) ní ọ̀pọ̀ ìgbà má ń ní HIV.
Zulu: Abantu ababulawa i-TB (isifo siyelapheka sibonge umshanguzo) ngokuvamile nabo bane-HIV.
Hausa: Mutanen da suka mutu a sanadiyyar TB (cutar ana iya warkewa ta hanyar magani) sau da yawa kuma suna ɗauke da cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Batho bao ba hlokofalago ka lebaka la TB (bolwetši bjo bo a alafega re leboga kalafo) gantši ba be ba na le HIV.
Amharic: በቲቢ የሚሞቱ ሰዎች (በሽታው ለህክምና ምስጋና ይግባውና የሚድን ነው) ብዙ ጊዜ ኤችአይቪ ነበራቸው።

English: TB must therefore be kept in mind whenever plans are made to control HIV in so-called high-burden countries that experience many cases.
Luganda: Kale nno TB alina okukuumirwa mu birowoozo buli enteekateeka z’okutangira HIV lwe zikolebwa mu mawanga ago agoogerwako ng’agali mu katuubagiro k’abalwadde abangi.
Yoruba: A gbọ́dọ̀ fi TB sọ́kàn nígbàkúgbà tí a bá ṣe èto láti ṣe ìṣàkóso HIV ní àwọn ibi ta pè ní orílẹ̀ èdè tó pọsí tí wọ́n ní ẹ̀sùn púpọ̀.
Zulu: Ngakho-ke i-TB kufanele ikhunjulwe noma nini lapho kwenziwa izinhlelo zokulawula i-HIV emazweni okuthiwa anomthwalo omkhulu abhekana nezigameko eziningi.
Hausa: Domin haka, dole ne a tuna da tarin TB a duk lokacin da aka yi shirin shawo kan cutar HIV a ƙasashen da ake kira masu nauyi waɗanda suke fama da cutar.
Northern Sotho: Ka fao TB e swanetše go dula e beilwe ka monaganong e ka ba maano a dirwa go laola HIV ka go seo se bitšwago dinaga tša phetetšo ya godimo tšeo di itemogelago malwetši a mantši.
Amharic: ብዙ ኬዞችን የሚያስተናግዱ ከፍተኛ ሸክም በሚኖርባቸው አገሮች ኤችአይቪን ለመቆጣጠር በታቀደ ቁጥር ቲቢ መታወስ አለበት።

English: And the same goes for HIV whenever TB is being discussed.
Luganda: Ate era y’ensonga y’emu ku HIV erina buli TB lw’aba ayogerwako.
Yoruba: Èyí náà sí lọ fún HIV bóyá wọ́n ń sọ̀rọ̀ nípa TB.
Zulu: Kuyafana nange-HIV noma nini lapho kuxoxwa nge-TB.
Hausa: Haka kuma a kan HIV a duk lokacin da ake maganar TB.
Northern Sotho: Gomme se se swana le HIV nako le nako ge go bolelwa ka ga TB.
Amharic: በተመሳሳይ ቲቢ ውይይት ላይ ሲቀርብ ለኤችአይቪም ይሰራል።

English: Mathematical models help researchers to see whether their treatment plans are working and will continue to work into the future.
Luganda: Emitetenkanyirizo kinnakubala giyamba abanoonyereza okulaba ng’enteekateeka zaabwe ez’obujjanjabi zikola era nga zijja kweyongera okukola ne mu maaso eyo.
Yoruba: Módẹ́ẹ̀lì matimátíìsì ń ṣe ìrànwọ́ fún àwọn olùṣèwádìí láti ri bóyá èto ìtọ́jú wọn ń ṣiṣẹ́ àti pé yóò ṣì máa ṣiṣẹ́ ní ọjọ́ iwájú.
Zulu: Amamodeli ezibalo asiza abacwaningi ukuthi babone ukuthi izinhlelo zabo zokwelapha ziyasebenza yini futhi zizoqhubeka nokusebenza esikhathini esizayo.
Hausa: Samfuran lissafin suna taimaka wa masu bincike su gani ko shirye-shiryensu na jiyya suna aiki kuma za su ci gaba da aiki a nan gaba.
Northern Sotho: Mekgwa ya mmetse e thuša banyakišiši go bona ge eba maano a bona a kalafo a a šoma le gore a tla tšwela pele go šoma ka moso.
Amharic: የሂሳብ ሞዴሎች ተመራማሪዎች የህክምና እቅዶቻቸው እየሰሩ መሆናቸውን እና ለወደፊቱም መስራታቸውን መቀጠላቸውን እንዲገነዘቡ ይረዷቸዋል።

English: In 2019, health scientists from the UK, USA and South Africa wrote a chapter together in a book called HIV and Tuberculosis.
Luganda: Mu 2019, bannassaayansi b’ebyobulamu e Bungereza, Amerika ne South Afirika baawandiika essuula bombi mu kitaob ekiyitibwa HIV n’Akafuba.
Yoruba: Ní 2019, àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì ìlera láti UK, USA àti South Africa kọ orí ìwé kan papọ̀ nínú ìwé tí wọ́n pè ní HIV àti Ikọ́ Ife.
Zulu: Ngowe-2019, ososayensi bezempilo base-UK, USA naseNingizimu Afrika babhala isahluko ndawonye encwadini ebizwa ngokuthi i-HIV and Tuberculosis.
Hausa: A shekarar 2019, masana kimiyya daga UK da USA da kuma Afirka ta Kudu sun rubuta babi tare a cikin wani littafi mai suna HIV da kuma Tuberculosis.
Northern Sotho: Ka 2019, bašomi ba tša mahlale ba maphelo go tšwa ka UK, USA le Afrika Borwa ba ile ba ngwala kgaolo ya ka pukung mmogo ka gare ga puku ye e bitšwago HIV and Tuberculosis.
Amharic: በ 2019፣ ከዩናይትድ ኪንግደም፣ ከአሜሪካ እና ከደቡብ አፍሪካ የመጡ የጤና ሳይንቲስቶች በጋራ ኤችአይቪ ኤንድ ቲዩበርክሎሲስ በተሰኘ መጽሐፍ ላይ አንድ ምዕራፍ ጻፉ።

English: They looked at the many modelling studies that have been done since the early 1990s to understand the co-occurrence of HIV and TB.
Luganda: Baatunuulira okunoonyereza okungi okw’emitetenkanyirizo okwakolebwa mu myaka gya 1990 nga gitandika okutegeera engeri obulwadde bwa HIV ne TB gye bukwatira awamu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n wo ọ̀pọ ẹ̀kọ́ módẹ́ẹ̀lì tí wọ́n ti ṣe láti 1990s láti ní òye ìjẹyọpọ̀ HIV àti TB.
Zulu: Babheke izifundo zokumodela eziningi ezenziwe kusukela ekuqaleni kwawo-1990 ukuze kuqondwe ukuhlangana kwe-HIV ne-TB.
Hausa: Sun duba yawancin nazarin ƙirar da aka yi tun farkon shekarun 1990 domin fahimtar haɗin kan aukuwar HIV da kuma TB.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba lekola dinyakišišo tše ntši tša tekodišišo tšeo di dirilwego go tloga ka mengwaga ya bo 1990 go kwešiša go hlaga mmogo ga HIV le TB.
Amharic: ከ1990ዎቹ መጀመሪያ ጀምሮ የኤችአይቪ እና የቲቢን አብሮ መከሰትን ለመረዳት የተደረጉትን ብዙ የሞዴሊንግ ጥናቶችን ተመልክተዋል።

English: They especially focussed on so-called dynamic models.
Luganda: Baasinga kwemaliza ku mitetenkanyirizo egyogerwako ng’egiganya enkyukakyuka.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àfojúsùn lórí ohun ta pè ní módẹ́ẹ̀lì oníyàtọ̀.
Zulu: Bagxile kakhulu kulokho okubizwa ngokuthi amamodeli aguquguqukayo.
Hausa: Musamman sun mayar da hankali a kan abin da ake kira samfurori masu ƙarfi.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba tloga ba lebelela kudu seo se bitšwgao mekgwa ye e fetogago.
Amharic: በተለይም ተለዋዋጭ ሞዴሎች ተብለው-በሚጠሩት ላይ አተኩረው ነበር።

English: These use data that show how infections transmit (spread) within specific populations, and how the risk of getting a disease depends on how widespread infections already are.
Luganda: Gino gikozesa obubaka obulaga engeri obulwadde gye busaasaana (okusaasaanyisibwa) mu bantu ab’engeri emu, ate n’obulabe bw’okusiigibwa obulwadde gye bwesigama ku ngeri ensaasaana y’obulwadde nga bw’efaanana.
Yoruba: Ìwọ̀nyí máa ń lo dátà tó ń fi ìkóran (ìtànká) láàárín àwọn olùgbé, àti ewu kíkó àìsàn náà ṣe dálé bí ó bá ṣe ti tànká tó.
Zulu: Lokhu kusebenzisa ingcobelelo ebonisa ukuthi izifo zidluliseka (ukusabalala) kanjani phakathi kwabantu abathile, nokuthi ingozi yokuthola isifo incike ekutheni izifo sezisabalele kangakanani.
Hausa: Wadannan suna amfani da bayanan da suke nuna yadda cututtuka suke yaɗawa (yaɗuwa) a cikin takamaiman al’umma, da kuma yadda haɗarin kamuwa da cuta ya dogara da yadda cututtuka suka yaɗu.
Northern Sotho: Mekgwa ye e šomiša tshedimošo yeo e laetšago ka fao diphetetšo di phatlalalago (fetelago) ka gona ka ditšhabeng tše itšego, le ka fao go ba kotsing ya go fetelwa ke bolwetši go laolwago ke ka fao diphetetšo di phatlalatšego kudu ka gona.
Amharic: እነዚህ ኢንፌክሽኖች በተወሰኑ ህዝቦች ውስጥ እንዴት እንደሚተላለፉ፣ እና እንዴት በበሽታ የመያዝ ዕድል ምን ያህል በወረርሽኙ መስፋፋት ላይ እንደሚመረኮዝ ለማሳየት መረጃን ይጠቀማሉ።

English: It also looks at how the number of cases change in response to plans being put into place.
Luganda: Essuula eyo etunuulira omuwendo gw’obalwadde gye gukyukakyukamu okusinziira ku nteekateeka eziteekebwawo.
Yoruba: Ó tún wo bí iye ẹ̀sun ṣe ń yí ní èsì sí ètò tí à ń fi sípò.
Zulu: Kuphinde kubhekwe ukuthi isibalo sezehlo sishintsha kanjani ekuphenduleni izinhlelo ezenziwayo.
Hausa: Haka nan yana duban yadda adadin kamuwa yake sauyawa dangane da shirye-shiryen da ake aiwatarwa.
Northern Sotho: E lebeletše gape ka fao palo ya balwetši e fetogago ka gona ka go arabela maano ao a tsentšwego tirišong.
Amharic: እንዲሁም ወደ ሥራ ላይ በተተገበሩ ዕቅዶች ምላሽ ላይ የኬዞች ቁጥር እንዴት እንደሚለወጥ ይመለከታል።

English: The authors included models in their review that first showed how TB and HIV infections increased over time, and how the emergence of HIV caused TB cases to increase considerably in the 1990s.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baateekamu emitetenkanyirizo mu kwekaliriza kwabwe egyasooka okulaga engeri obulwadde bwa TB ne HIV gye bweyongera oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera, ate n’engeri okubalukawo kwa HIV gye kwaleeteramu obulwadde bwa TB okweyongera ennyo mu myaka 1990.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùkọ̀wé náà ṣe àfikún àwọn módẹ́ẹ̀lì sínú àyẹ̀wò wọn tó kọ́kọ́ fi bí TB àti HIV ṣe gbèrú sí i, àti bí ìgbésókè HIV ṣe fa ẹ̀sun TB sókẹ̀ ní àwọn ọdún 1990s.
Zulu: Ababhali bafaka amamodeli ekubuyekezweni kwabo aqale akhombisa ukuthi ukutheleleka kwe-TB ne-HIV kwanda kanjani ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, nokuthi ukuvela kwe-HIV kwabangela kanjani ukuba amacala e-TB anyuke kakhulu ngeminyaka yawo-1990.
Hausa: Marubutan sun haɗa da samfurori a cikin bitarsu da suka fara nuna yadda cutar TB da kuma HIV suke ƙaruwa a kan lokaci, da kuma yadda ɓullowar cutar HIV ta haifar da gagarumin ƙaruwar cutar TB a cikin shekarun 1990.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba akareditše mekgwa ka tekodišiong ya bona yeo mathomong e laeditšego ka fao diphetetšo tša TB le tša HIV di ilego tša oketšega ka gona ge nako e dutše e sepela, le ka fao go tšwelela ga HIV go bakilego gore diphetetšo tša TB di hlatloge kudu ka mengwageng ya bo1990.
Amharic: ደራሲዎቹ በግምገማቸው ውስጥ በመጀመሪያ የቲቢ እና የኤችአይቪ ኢንፌክሽኖች ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ እንዴት እንደሚጨምሩ፣ እና የኤችአይቪ መከሰት እንዴት በ1990ዎቹ የቲቢ ኬዞችን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንዲጨምር እንዳደረገ የሚያሳዩ ሞዴሎችን አካተዋል።

English: The researchers also reflected on models that showed how using ARTs and other control methods have helped to bring this number down in populations.
Luganda: Era abanoonyereza beefumiitiriza ku mitetenkanyirizo egyalaga engeri y’okukozesaamu ARTs n’obukodyo obulala obutangira endwadde gye bwayamba okukendeeza ku muwendo ogwo mu bantu.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí ronú lóríi àwọn módẹ́ẹ̀lì tó se àfihàn bí a ṣe ń lo ARTs àti àwọn ìlànà ìṣàkóso mìíràn ti ṣe ìrànwọ́ láti mu iye nọ́ḿbà yìí wá sílẹ̀ láàárín àwọn olùgbé.

Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma yi la’akari da samfurori da suka nuna yadda amfani da ARTs da sauran hanyoyin magancewa suka taimaka wajen rage wannan adadi a cikin yawan jama'a.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba lekotše gape mekgwa ye e laeditšego ka fao di-ART le mekgwa ye mengwe ya taolo ya boolwetši e thušitšego go fokotša palo ye ka ditšhabeng.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ARTs እና ሌሎች የቁጥጥር ዘዴዎችን መጠቀም ይህንን ቁጥር በህዝብ ቁጥሮች ውስጥ እንዴት ዝቅ ለማድረግ እንደረዳ የሚያሳዩ ሞዴሎች ላይ አንፀባርቀዋል።

English: They also reviewed the different uses and achievements of TB and HIV modelling, and made suggestions on how it can be used in future.
Luganda: Era beekaliriza emigezo egy’enjawulo n’ebyatuukibwako mu mitetenkanyirizo gya TB ne HIV, era ne bateesa ku ngeri gye giyinza okukozesebwamu gye bujja.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ṣe àyẹ̀wo ìyàtọ ìlò àti àṣeyọrí TB àti módẹ́ẹ̀lì HIV, wó sì dábàá lórí i bí a ṣe lè lò ó ní ọjọ́ iwájú.
Zulu: Baphinde babuyekeza ukusetshenziswa okuhlukene kanye nempumelelo yokumodela i-TB ne-HIV, futhi benza iziphakamiso zokuthi ingasetshenziswa kanjani esikhathini esizayo.
Hausa: Har wa yau, sun yi nazari a kan amfani da nasarori daban-daban da aka samu wajen yin samfurin TB da kuma HIV, tare da bayar da shawarwari a kan yadda za a yi amfani da shi nan gaba.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba lekola mehola le diphihlelelo tše di fapanego tša tekodišišo ya TB le HIV, gomme ba dira ditšhišinyo mabapi le ka fao e ka šomišwago ka moso.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም የቲቢ እና የኤችአይቪ ሞዴሊንግ የተለያዩ አጠቃቀሞችን እና የተገኙ ውጤቶችን ገምግመዋል እና ለወደፊት እንዴት ጥቅም ላይ እንደሚውል አስተያየት ሰጥተዋል።

English: The researchers believe that despite TB and HIV together afflicting up to 1 million people worldwide each year, it has not received enough attention from modellers working on the spread of diseases (which is known as epidemiology).
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bakkiriza nti newankubadde nga TB ne HIV bikosa abantu abakunukkiriza mu kakadde 1 mu nsi yonna buli mwaka, bannamitetenkanyirizo abakola ku nsaasaana y’obulwadde (ekimanyiddwa nga okwekaliriza obulwadde) tebannaba kubufaako bulungi.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí náà gbàgbọ́ pé pẹ̀lú akitiyan TB àti HIV tó ń bá bí i ènìyan mílíọ́ọ̀nù 1 káàkiriri àgbáyé jà ní ọdọọdún, kò tí ì rí àkíyèsí tó tẹ̀wọ̀n tó láti ọ̀dọ àwọn aṣe módẹ́ẹ̀lì lórí ìtànká àìsàn (tí a mọ̀ sí ìmọ ìmójútó àìsàn).
Zulu: Abacwaningi bakholelwa ukuthi naphezu kokuba i-TB ne-HIV ndawonye kuhlupha abantu abafinyelela esigidini esisodwa emhlabeni wonke unyaka ngamunye, ayikakutholi ukunakwa okwanele kwabamodelayo abasebenza ekusakazeni izifo (okwaziwa nge-epidemiology).
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi imanin cewa, duk da TB da kuma HIV tare da suke addabar mutane miliyan 1 a duk duniya a kowace shekara, bai sami isasshen kulawa daga masu yin koyi da suke aiki a kan yaɗuwar cututtuka ba (wanda aka fi sani da epidemiology).
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba dumela gore ka ntle le gore TB le HIV di ama batho ba go fihla go ba milione o 1 lefaseng ka bophara ngwaga o mongwe le o mongwe, se ga se sa hwetša šedi ye kgolo go tšwa go balekodi bao ba šomago ka ga go phatlalatšwa ga malwetši (e lego seo se tsebjago bjalo ka thutatwetši).

English: The authors acknowledged that it is genuinely difficult and complex to try and handle two conditions together that are, on their own, very complicated to understand, control and treat.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bakiraba nti kizibu ddala era kikaluba okufa ku mbeera ebbiri olumu, ate nga zombi zizitowa, zikaluba okutegeera, okuziyiza n’okujjanjaba.
Yoruba: Àwọn òǹkọ̀wé náà gbà pé ó ṣòro ó sì le láti ṣe ohun méjì pọ̀, tí ìkọ̀ọ̀kan fúnra rẹ̀, le láti nín òye nípa, ṣèsàkóso àti mójútó.
Zulu: Ababhali bavumile ukuthi kunzima ngempela futhi kuyinkimbinkimbi ukuzama ukubhekana nezimo ezimbili ndawonye, ​​zona ngokwazo, eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu ukuqonda, ukulawula nokuphatha.
Hausa: Marubutan sun yarda cewa yana da matuƙar wahala da sarƙaƙƙiya domin gwadawa da kula da yanayi guda biyu tare waɗanda, a kan kansu, suna da wahalar fahimta da sarrafawa da kuma magancewa.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba dumetše gore go tloga go le boima le go hlakahlakana go leka go lwantšha malwetši a ka bobedi e lego, ka bowona, a hlakahlakane kudu go a kwešiša, go a laola le tšhošetšo ya ona.

English: To develop adequate models is therefore not an easy task.

Hausa: Don haɓaka isassun samfura don haka ba abu ne mai sauƙi ba.
Northern Sotho: Go hlama mekgwa ya maleba ka fao ke mošomo o bonolo.

English: The job requires data to work with, and the combined team effort of skilled experts.
Luganda: Omulimu ogwo gwetaaga obubaka obw’okukolerako, ate n’abakugu okubeera nga bakolera wamu kitole.

Luganda: Okugeza, balina okumanya omutetenkanyirizo ogulina okukozesebwa ku nsonga eba etunuulirwa.

Luganda: Wadde nga guli gutyo, emitetenkanyirizo bwe gityo gisobola okuyamba aboobuyinza n’abasakirizi okuwandiika amateeka n’enteekateeka ebirungi ebikwata ku bintu ebyokuteekamu ssente n’engeri y’okuzisaasaanya okusobola okulwanyisa TB ne HIV.
Yoruba: Wàyí o, irúfẹ́ àwọn módẹ́ẹ̀lì lè ran àwọn alákóso àti akówóṣiṣẹ́ láti kọ àwọn òfin gidi àti ètò nípa ibi àti bí wọ́n ṣe lẹ̀ ná owó láti ṣàkóso àti ṣèdíwọ́ TB àti HIV.
Zulu: Noma kunjalo, amamodeli anjalo angasiza iziphathimandla kanye nabaxhasi bezimali ukuthi babhale imigomo nezinhlelo ezinhle mayelana nokuthi kufanele bayisebenzise kuphi futhi kanjani imali ukuze balawule futhi bavimbele i-TB ne-HIV.

English: They can, for instance, help to locate specific hot spots in a community that are often the scene of high numbers of infections, because of tight social contact and poor ventilation.

Zulu: Angakwazi, ngokwesibonelo, ukusiza ekutholeni izindawo ezithile ezishisayo emphakathini ovame ukuba yisizinda senani eliphezulu lokutheleleka ngenxa yokuxhumana okuqinile komphakathi kanye nokungangeni komoya kahle.
Hausa: Suna iyawa, alal misali, taimakawa wajen gano takamaiman wurare masu zafi a cikin al’umma waɗanda galibi ake yawan kamuwa da cututtuka, saboda matsananciyar hulɗar jama’a da rashin samun wadatacciyar iska.
Northern Sotho: Ba ka, go fa mohlala, thuša go nyaka mafelo ao a itšego a tletšego ka diphetetšo ka setšhabeng ao gantši e lego mafelo a diphetetšo tša godimo tša diphetetšo, ka lebaka la go kopana kudu ga batho setšheng le tlhokego ya tsenyomoya.

English: Relatively easy plans can then be put into place to prevent further infections from happening.
Luganda: Mu ngeri eyo, enteekateeka ennyangu zisobola okuteekebwawo okuziyiza okweyongera kw’okusaasaana kw’obulwadde.

English: Modelling can provide health scientists and officials with greater insights into how the diseases spread, what the long term impact of control efforts such as ARTs are, and how the situation might look in future.
Luganda: Okutetenkanya okw’engeri eyo kusobola okuyamba bannassaayansi n’aboobuyinza okwongera okutegeera engeri obulwadde gye busaasaana, okukosa okw’amaanyi okuva mu kaweefube w’okutangira obulwadde gamba nga okukozesa ARTs ate n’embeera nga bw’eyinza okufaanana.
Yoruba: Ìṣe módẹ́ẹ̀lì le ṣe ìpèsè fún àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì ìlere àti àwọn adarí pẹ̀lú ojú inú tó péye síní bí àìsàn náà ṣe ń di títànká, ohun tí ipa ọjọ́ iwájú lórí ìṣàkóso àwọn akitiyan bí i ARTs jẹ́, àti bí ìṣe náà yóò ṣe rí ní ọjọ́ iwájú.
